acceptance: DataGenerationManifest emits optional generator_backend and generator_backend_version fields while remaining the sole writer of _datagen_manifest.json; existing legacy manifests pass validation with zero cache invalidation or hash drift.

datagen_version.py supports per-benchmark generator versioning without changing global DATA_GENERATION_VERSION, includes backend, backend version, and Parquet-writer identity in compute_datagen_identity_hash(), and flags backend mismatch as stale in manifest_datagen_is_current() whenever outputs are not byte-identical.

benchbox/utils/datagen_backend.py implements --datagen-backend legacy|native (no auto mode, no silent fallback) and a per-benchmark default table initialized with every benchmark on legacy, wired into both benchbox datagen and benchbox run.
Explicit --datagen-backend native on an unsupported benchmark, unsupported platform, or missing optional extra fails loudly with an actionable error naming the fix.
runner.py _attach_datagen_version propagates the updated data_generation_hash cleanly, verified by unit tests.
context: Phase 1 step 1 foundation of the faster data-generation plan. Provides safe cache isolation, per-benchmark versioning, and opt-in backend routing so Tier 1 (tpcgen-cli), Tier 2 (SSB), and Tier 3 (synthetic) generators can be constructed and verified in parallel without risking existing runs.
description:
## Problem
BenchBox currently has no generator backend selector, compute_datagen_identity_hash() in benchbox/utils/datagen_version.py omits backend and Parquet-writer identity, and DATA_GENERATION_VERSION feeds compute_base_constants_hash() globally for every benchmark. Without per-benchmark versioning and backend-aware cache reuse checks, parallel generator construction cannot safely coexist with shared datagen/ folders ([RUN-DATA-001]).

## Change
- Extend DataGenerationManifest (benchbox/utils/datagen_manifest.py) with optional additive fields generator_backend and generator_backend_version while keeping Python as the sole _datagen_manifest.json writer.
- Extend benchbox/utils/datagen_version.py with a per-benchmark generator version registry (leaving global DATA_GENERATION_VERSION unchanged), include backend, backend version, and Parquet-writer identity in compute_datagen_identity_hash(), and update manifest_datagen_is_current() / describe_datagen_staleness() to enforce backend reuse safety when outputs are not byte-identical.
- Create benchbox/utils/datagen_backend.py implementing backend resolution from --datagen-backend legacy|native and a per-benchmark default table initialized with every benchmark on legacy. Omit auto mode and forbid silent fallback.
- Wire --datagen-backend into benchbox/cli/commands/datagen.py and benchbox/cli/commands/run.py, and ensure runner.py (_attach_datagen_version) propagates data_generation_hash cleanly.

## Decision gates
- Follow the exact provenance and default-resolution rules approved in docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md.
- Stop and report if any existing legacy manifest or test fixture hash changes unexpectedly for legacy runs.

## Guardrails
- NEVER bump global DATA_GENERATION_VERSION (it hashes every benchmark and would invalidate all cached datasets).
- No auto backend mode and no silent fallback when native is explicitly requested on an unsupported benchmark, unsupported platform, or missing optional extra.
- Keep every benchmark defaulted to legacy in this item; zero behavior change for runs omitting --datagen-backend.
- Enforce [RUN-DATA-001] shared-folder safety and AGENTS.md PR workflow ([COMMENT-POLICY-001], make pr-preflight, merged PR).
